# coolify_hostinger_templates (Data Source)

Lists Hostinger OS templates. Requires Coolify >= v4.5.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_hostinger_templates" "all" {
  cloud_provider_token_uuid = coolify_cloud_token.hostinger.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_token_uuid` (String) UUID of a Hostinger cloud provider token used to list templates.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) OS templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Template description.
- `documentation` (String) Documentation URL or text from Hostinger.
- `id` (Number) Template id. Pass this to `coolify_server_hostinger.template_id`.
- `name` (String) Template name.
